faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SLS AMG GT use?
faqLeft.a: The SLS AMG GT uses the M159 — a 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8. This was the only combustion engine fitted to the SLS AMG range, including the GT and Black Series variants. The SLS AMG Electric Drive was a separate fully electric variant.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SLS AMG GT engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500 for the M159 V8. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SLS AMG GT?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the M159 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M159 SLS AMG GT engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve train components, head gaskets and bearings as standard on every M159 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SLS AMG GT engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SLS AMG GT if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SLS AMG GT engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SLS AMG GT owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
